name: Big Sky
isolated_lifts_note: Two platters south-east of the Lewis and Clark area with no mapped run from their tops (OpenStreetMap 773673147, 773673148); likely private club lifts. Check against the resort's lift list.

extra_trails.name: Orbit
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): chute below the north summit cliffs, tied to the ground with 15 control points (lift tops, run tops on the ridge; median leave-one-out error 114 m), then fitted to the terrain so it never climbs. Above the treeline: approximate (about 100 m)

extra_trails.name: Trident
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): three chutes joining into one line on the north summit face; the main line placed from 15 control points (median error 114 m) and fitted to the terrain. Approximate (about 100 m)
extra_trails.fitted: terrain: never climbs, moved 1 m on average

extra_trails.name: Double Direct
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): north summit chute placed from 15 control points (median error 114 m) and fitted to the terrain; the map's order on the face (Orbit, Double Direct, Summit Direct, Tears, Great Falls) kept. Approximate

extra_trails.name: Summit Direct
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): north summit chute between Double Direct and Tears, placed from 15 control points (median error 114 m), fitted to the terrain. Approximate

extra_trails.name: Tears
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): north summit chute next to Great Falls, placed from 15 control points (median error 114 m), fitted to the terrain. Approximate

extra_trails.name: Kastle Rock (A-Z)
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 Bowl inset (skimap.org 48809): short chute off the A-Z ridge between Upper A-Z Chutes and Parachute (A-Z), placed by that order on the ridge and the fall line. Approximate (about 100 m)

extra_trails.name: Zucchini Patch
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 Bowl inset (skimap.org 48809): label and symbol for a tree area between Little Tree and Highway, no drawn line; drawn down the middle of that area along the fall line. Approximate

extra_trails.name: 0-3 Cache Trees
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 Bowl inset (skimap.org 48809): label and symbol for a tree area below LRT Traverse, south of Little Tree, no drawn line; drawn down its upper part. Approximate

extra_trails.name: 1-3 Little Gullies
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 Bowl inset (skimap.org 48809): label and symbol for a tree area below 0-3 Cache Trees, between Little Tree and Dead Top, no drawn line; drawn down its lower part. Approximate

extra_trails.name: Mr. Ed
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): green run in the base slow zone from Mr. K toward the S1 and S3 carpets, between Chet's Knob and Huntley Hollow. Open ground, so no strip to check: approximate (about 50 m)

extra_trails.name: PK Ridge
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): placed from 13 control points (median leave-one-out error 186 m), then moved onto the open strip in the 1 m canopy height map (Meta/WRI) not taken by another run: tree cover on the line 1% (22% before), moved 22 m on average

extra_trails.name: Cutbank
extra_trails.why: Big Sky 2026-27 trail map (skimap.org 48804): placed from 13 control points (median error 186 m), then moved onto the open strip in the 1 m canopy height map (Meta/WRI) not taken by another run: tree cover on the line 1% (29% before), moved 27 m on average

links_notes.Tears / Summit Direct (bottom): the trail map ends both north summit chutes on the open slope of Deepwater Bowl, which leads to Horseshoe and the Lone Tree lift (traced 2026-11-23)
